name: Brock Purdy
title: Professional Football Quarterback
bio: Brock Purdy is an American football quarterback who played for Iowa State before the San Francisco 49ers selected him with the final pick of the 2022 NFL draft. He became the team’s starting quarterback during his rookie season and later played in Super Bowl LVIII. His public interviews also describe a source of identity that does not depend on football: faith in Jesus Christ.
faith: Purdy’s public witness predates his NFL career: a 2021 Sports Spectrum interview discussed the importance of Christ in his life and his desire to live set apart from the world. In a 2023 interview, quoted by Sports Spectrum in January 2024, he affirmed that Jesus died for his sins and rose again, and said his identity must be in Christ rather than football. In February 2024, he explained that his prayers during games were not requests to win, but for peace, steadfastness, and the Holy Spirit’s guidance. Describing his daily reading of Psalm 23, he said, “I already have what I need from the Good Shepherd in Jesus.” That is Purdy’s reflection on the psalm, not a quotation of its text. He also described fellowship and Bible studies with fellow believers on the team as important support amid the pressures of professional sport. His testimony points to contentment in Christ, not athletic achievement as proof of God’s favor.
tagline: Finding identity and contentment in Christ, not the scoreboard
